subject: Subvendor exemption evaluation — requested DPA amendment + evidence
messages:
From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: contracts@oceaniccloud.com, olivia@oceaniccloud.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 08 Jan 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Subvendor addition — DPA amendment and evidence request

Hi Olivia / Oceanic legal team,

Thanks for confirming the planned subvendor (EdgeProc) for the log ingestion pipeline. Before we can proceed with signature on the Order Form we need two items from you:

1) A redline of the DPA that narrows the subprocessor flow-down to only the EdgeProc service used for ingestion and provides the standard data use limitations we discussed. Ideally a single redline PDF showing the subproc clause language.

2) Evidence package for EdgeProc: SOC 2 snapshot or equivalent, data retention policy excerpt, and the network topology diagram showing that EdgeProc does not have persistent access to our customer content after ingestion. A short CSV manifest listing the artifacts (filename + date) is fine.

I've attached our current redline for the Order Form (OrderForm_OceanicCloud_Redline_v3.pdf) that incorporates the price and SLA changes — please do not change commercial terms in the DPA redline.

Laura (Legal) / Karthik (Procurement) — looping you in to parallel-track review. If Oceanic cannot produce the DPA redline scoped to EdgeProc, we'll need to evaluate a scoped exception and an escrow-like mitigation (e.g., additional audit rights + restricted retention windows).

Can you confirm a target for these artifacts by EOD Tuesday 2026-01-13?

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior Contract Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: OrderForm_OceanicCloud_Redline_v3.pdf (PDF, 235KB)

From: Olivia Barnes <olivia@oceaniccloud.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Cc: contracts@oceaniccloud.com
Date: Thu, 08 Jan 2026 11:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Subvendor addition — DPA amendment and evidence request

Kimberly — thanks for the clear list. A few quick points:

- We can produce a DPA redline that limits the flow-down to EdgeProc, but legal prefers to keep a single parent clause and annotate the service list rather than create separate bespoke clauses per subvendor. We'll send a redline and a clean copy for your review.

- SOC 2: EdgeProc is in the middle of a rolling SOC cycle; we can provide last year's report with a review memo plus the security questionnaire responses mapping controls to ingestion.

- Topology: we will provide the requested diagram and a short CSV manifest.

One ask: if Redwood requires audit rights beyond our standard, we'll need to see the proposed wording for the exception route. Can Laura draft suggested language for an exception path (timeboxed) so we can evaluate?

We'll aim to get the bundle to you by Monday EOD (2026-01-12).

Best,
Olivia
Head of Legal Ops
Oceanic Cloud

Attachments: none

From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: olivia@oceaniccloud.com
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, dev_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 09 Jan 2026 08:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Subvendor addition — DPA amendment and evidence request

Olivia — appreciated. Drafting a conservative exception path now; proposing the following approach for discussion:

- Short-term exception (90 days) that permits signature on the Order Form conditional on delivery of the evidence package and a second-party verification (attestation) within 45 days;
- Additional audit right limited to a scoped tabletop exercise for ingestion flows (no live data access) executed at Oceanic's site or via recorded sessions;
- Mandatory data retention cap for EdgeProc of 7 days for raw ingest logs unless otherwise required for troubleshooting, with documented escalation for retention exceptions.

If you can provide the redline and the artifacts by Monday, we'll aim to insert the exception wording as a tracked change in the DPA so you can quickly accept or counter.

Also cc'ing Dev (infra) — Dev, please confirm the specific network/port controls we should require in the topology (e.g., is egress limited, ephemeral credentials, etc.) so I can include technical requirements.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Contracts
Redwood Inference

From: dev_patel@redwood.ai
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 12 Jan 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Subvendor addition — DPA amendment and evidence request

Laura / Kim — quick tech notes to include in the DPA redline (or the attachment security annex):

- EdgeProc must use ephemeral credentials (rotated daily) for ingestion; no long-lived keys.
- Ingestion layer should strip PII at the earliest transform, with a documented sanitization pipeline.
- EdgeProc should not persist raw customer payloads beyond 24 hours except for queued retries; if queued for troubleshooting, retention must be approved and logged.
- Network: egress only to the ingestion endpoint IP range we provide; all connections TLS1.3.

I can add a short appendix to the evidence bundle showing how these controls map to the artifacts you asked for.

—Dev

From: contracts@oceaniccloud.com
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 12 Jan 2026 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Subvendor addition — DPA amendment and evidence request

Team — attached deliverables (zipped): subprocessor_evidence_manifest.csv, EdgeProc_Topology.png, EdgeProc_SOC2_summary.pdf.

We are also uploading the DPA redline and a clean copy to DocSend: https://docsend.com/d/oc-oceanic-dpa-v3.

Next steps we propose:
1) Redwood reviews the DPA redline and confirms whether the proposed service-list approach is acceptable.
2) If an exception path is required, Laura's 90-day conditional approach seems reasonable — can Redwood confirm acceptance in writing so we can finalize the Order Form?
3) If acceptable, we'll prepare DocuSign routing for the Order Form + DPA.

Olivia (for Oceanic Contracts)

Attachments: subprocessor_evidence_manifest.csv (CSV, 4KB); EdgeProc_Topology.png (PNG, 87KB); EdgeProc_SOC2_summary.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB)
